installation_admin.description: May manage backups, the global audit log and account suspension.

AutoClosed.description: A task the automation changed in the same request (`auto_closed` in PATCH and bulk responses).

BackupArchive.description: A backup snapshot as a ZIP archive: `{id}/manifest.json`, `{id}/database.sqlite` and `{id}/attachments/…`.

byte_size.description: Total size of the database and attachment files in the snapshot.

duplicate_of_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: mark this task as a duplicate of it. `null`: unmark.

parent_task_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: make this task its sub-issue. `null`: detach.

member_ids.description: Workspace members to add besides the caller.

name.description: Stored trimmed, in lower case, with `-` for spaces; at most 80 characters.

oneOf.description: Edits, reactions, pins and thread summary changes.
The receiver lost access (left or was removed from a private channel).

ChatEvent.description: One change, as the live socket sends it and as a write's response lists it.

ChatEvents.description: A write without a record of its own.

mime_type.description: Detected from the file's bytes, not taken from the client.

url.description: Same-origin download path; usable as an image `src` or a file link.

width.description: Of an image, as the uploader's browser measured it.

before_id.description: The category to put it before; null for the end.
The channel of that category to put it before; null for the end.

category_id.description: The category to put the channel in; null for the channels without a category.

ChatRestoreBody.description: The read cursors to put back: the `states` and `threads` that `read-all` returned.

also_in_channel.description: A thread reply that also shows in the conversation.

body.description:
Markdown source, at most 4000 characters. Mentions are tokens: `<@user_id>`,
`<#conversation_id>`, `<!channel>`, `<!here>`.

file_ids.description:
Files the caller uploaded for this message (at most 10). With files the body may be
empty.

nonce.description:
Made by the caller (1–64 bytes). A send that is tried again with the same nonce returns
the first message.

thread_root_id.description: The root message, for a thread reply.

ChatWrite_CategoryRecord.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

ChatWrite_ConversationRecord.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

is_default.description: `#general`: every member is in it and it cannot be left, archived or made private.

name.description: Empty for a DM: its title is made from the other members' names.

ChatWrite_ConversationStateRecord.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

result.description: The caller's state in one conversation.

mention_count.description: Unread `@user` mentions, plus `@channel` and `@here` unless the conversation is muted.

unread_count.description: Unread messages in the main list, written by other members.

ChatWrite_MessageRecord.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

also_in_channel.description: A thread reply that also shows in the conversation's main list.

deleted.description: A deleted root that still has replies stays in the list with an empty body.

id.description: UUIDv7: message ids sort by creation time, and every list orders by them.

nonce.description: Echo of the sender's nonce, so the sender can replace its optimistic row.

reply_count.description: Thread summary; meaningful on a root only.

reply_user_ids.description: The first reply authors (at most five).

ChatWrite_ReadSnapshot.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

result.description: The states that "mark all as read" changed, as they were before, so the caller can undo it.

ChatWrite_ThreadStateRecord.description:
The changed record and the chat events that this write caused for the caller. The events
are the same records that the live socket sends; `seq` is the socket's number of the last
one, so a client that got a later event on its socket leaves these out.

result.description: The caller's state in one thread.

can_delete.description: Whether the caller may delete this comment.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this comment.

value.description:
An array of strings, a date value, a pair of date values, or a string, depending on
`field` and `operator`. Omitted for `is_empty` and `is_not_empty`.

is_default.description: `#general`: every member is in it and it cannot be left, archived or made private.

name.description: Empty for a DM: its title is made from the other members' names.

ConversationStateRecord.description: The caller's state in one conversation.

mention_count.description: Unread `@user` mentions, plus `@channel` and `@here` unless the conversation is muted.

unread_count.description: Unread messages in the main list, written by other members.

token.description:
A Notion personal access token (recommended) or internal connection token. Validated
with Notion, stored encrypted, and deleted when the import ends.

parent_id.description:
With a parent the page joins the parent's space; contradicting `teamspace_id` or
`private` values fail validation.

position.description: Index among the new siblings; omitted appends the page last.

private.description: Root pages only: `true` creates the page in the caller's private space.

teamspace_id.description:
Root pages only: the target teamspace. Omitted (and not `private`) uses the default
teamspace.

title.description: Defaults to an empty title; clients show "Untitled".

body.description:
The first comment: BlockNote blocks of the comment editor (paragraphs with `text`, `link`
and `mention` inline content, mention props `{ userId, name }`).

quote.description: The selected text the thread is about (trimmed, at most 1000 characters are kept).

parent_task_id.description: Create the task as a sub-issue of this task.

sub_issues.description: Optional in stored and received states (default `nested`).

include_children.description: Also copy the page's live sub-pages (the whole subtree, in order). Defaults to `false`.

FilterGroup.description: An AND/OR group. An empty group matches every task.

FilterNode.description: A nested group or a condition; groups carry `op` and `children`.

can_change_role.description: Whether the caller may change this member's role.

can_remove.description: Whether the caller may remove this member (for the caller's own row: leave).

can_transfer_ownership.description: Whether the caller may hand the workspace over to this member.

suspended_at.description: Set while the user's account is suspended (they cannot sign in or be notified).

MentionsRecord.description: Who the body mentions, parsed from its tokens.

MessageKind.description: `pin`, `join` and `leave` are one-line system rows; `author_id` is the member they are about.

MessagePage.description: Messages in ascending order. A null cursor means there is nothing more in that direction.

also_in_channel.description: A thread reply that also shows in the conversation's main list.

deleted.description: A deleted root that still has replies stays in the list with an empty body.

id.description: UUIDv7: message ids sort by creation time, and every list orders by them.

nonce.description: Echo of the sender's nonce, so the sender can replace its optimistic row.

reply_count.description: Thread summary; meaningful on a root only.

reply_user_ids.description: The first reply authors (at most five).

position.description: Index among the caller's visible favorites; larger values move it last.

parent_id.description:
The new parent; `null` moves the page to a space root. The page and its whole subtree
take the parent's space.

private.description:
With `parent_id: null`: `true` moves the page into the caller's private space, `false`
out of it (to the default teamspace unless `teamspace_id` is given).

teamspace_id.description: With `parent_id: null`: the target teamspace. Omitted keeps the page's current space.

position.description:
Index among the workspace's teamspaces; larger values move it last. Index 0 makes it the
default teamspace.

NewTaskRelationType.description: Relation types a client can create. Duplicates go through `duplicate_of_id` on task updates.

chat_conversation_id.description: Conversation and message of a `chat_mentioned` notification.

comment_id.description: The task comment of a `comment_mentioned` notification.

kind.description:
`task_assigned`, `comment_mentioned` (task comment), `page_comment_mentioned`,
`page_mentioned` (an @mention in a page body) or `chat_mentioned` (a chat message).

page_block_id.description: The block with the mention of a `page_mentioned` notification (a deep link anchor).

page_id.description:
Page, thread and comment of a `page_comment_mentioned` notification; the page of a
`page_mentioned` one.

NotionImport.description: A Notion import. Never contains the token.

oneOf.description: Set once the import was started.

error.description: Why the import failed or expired.

notion_workspace_name.description:
The Notion workspace name (connection tokens) or the token owner's name (personal
access tokens).

oneOf.description: Conversion summary, once the import started.

root_page_ids.description: The imported top-level pages that still exist, in order (for "Open imported pages").

oneOf.description:
The scan result, once ready. Only in `GET …/imports/notion/{id}?include=tree`; `null`
everywhere else (the default detail, lists, create, start and cancel), so polling
stays light.

NotionImportDestination.description: Where the import puts its root pages.

parent_page_id.description: The page the imported root pages go under, if any.

NotionImportDestinationBody.description:
Where the imported top-level pages go. With `parent_page_id` they become its sub-pages
(and join its space); otherwise they go to the root of `teamspace_id`, of the caller's
private space (`private: true`), or of the default teamspace.

NotionImportFailure.description: A page the import could not create or fill.

NotionImportNode.description: One node of the scan tree.

icon.description: Emoji icon, when the Notion icon is an emoji.

notion_id.description: Dashed lowercase Notion id; use it in `selection.notion_ids`.

parent_id.description:
The parent node's `notion_id`; `null` for a root (top-level, or its parent is not
visible to the token).

NotionImportNodeKind.description: A Notion page or database in the scan tree.

total.description: Pages to import (pages, databases and database rows).

NotionImportReport.description: What the conversion could not carry over, summed over all imported pages.

files_imported.description: Files downloaded and attached to the new pages.

lossy.description: Blocks converted with information loss, by kind.

missing_files.description: Notion-hosted files that could not be downloaded.

previously_imported.description: Selected pages this member imported before (the import creates new copies).

truncated_blocks.description: Top-level blocks cut from pages larger than the page size limit.

unfilled_pages_trashed.description:
Pages the import created but never filled because it failed or was cancelled; they
were moved to the trash (a restored page no longer counts).

unresolved_page_links.description: Links to Notion pages that were not part of the import (they still point to Notion).

NotionImportSelectionBody.description:
`{ "all": true }` for everything the token can see, or `{ "notion_ids": [...] }` for these
pages and all their sub-pages.

NotionImportTree.description:
What the token can see. `nodes` are in tree order: every parent before its children,
siblings in Notion creation order.

incomplete.description: Notion returned an incomplete search result; some pages may be missing.

truncated.description: The token sees more than 5,000 pages; only the first 5,000 are listed.

collab_epoch.description:
Identifies the page's collaborative document. Pass it as the `epoch` query parameter of
the co-editing socket (`GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/pages/{page_id}/collab`); it
changes when the stored document is reset (backup restore, converter change), and a
socket opened with an older value is closed with 4409.

content.description: BlockNote blocks; opaque to the server.

full_width.description: The editor column uses the whole pane width.

locked_at.description:
Set while the page is locked: title, icon, cover and content writes answer 423
`page_locked` (REST, version restore, imports) and the co-editing socket ignores content
updates. Moving, trashing, duplicating and `full_width` stay allowed.

oneOf.description: Who locked the page (`null` when unlocked, or when that user no longer exists).

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space (`teamspace_id` is `null`).

teamspace_id.description: The page's teamspace; `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

updated_by_user.description: The last editor (`updated_by`) with their display name.

PageComment.description: One comment of a thread. A deleted comment keeps its place with an empty body.

body.description:
BlockNote blocks (paragraphs; inline `text`, `link` and `mention {userId, name}`); `[]`
once deleted.

body_text.description: Plain text of the body (mentions as `@name`).

mentioned_user_ids.description: Members this comment mentions who can see the page.

body.description: BlockNote blocks of the comment editor (see `CreatePageThreadBody.body`).

PageFavorite.description:
One of the caller's favorite pages. `position` is the index among the caller's visible
favorites.

PageFavoriteList.description: The caller's favorites in this workspace, ordered by position.

PageFile.description: A file attached to a page.

mime_type.description: Detected from the file's bytes, not taken from the client.

url.description:
Same-origin download path (`/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/pages/{page_id}/files/{id}`);
usable as an image `src`, a file link, or the page's `cover_url`.

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space.

snippet.description:
Plain body text around the best match (about 24 words, `…` where text was cut), or the
start of the body when only the title matched.

teamspace_id.description: `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

PageSummary.description: Page metadata for the tree, without content.

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space.

teamspace_id.description: `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

PageThread.description: A comment thread on a page, with its comments oldest first.

quote.description: The text selected when the thread was started.

items.description: Open and resolved threads, oldest first.

purged.description: Trash entries (pages trashed directly) deleted forever, sub-pages not counted.

cover_position.description: Absent: unchanged. `null`: cleared. Otherwise `"x,y"` percentages from 0 to 100.

cover_url.description:
Absent: unchanged. `null`: cleared. Otherwise an http(s) URL, or the `url` of a file
uploaded to this same page (`/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/pages/{page_id}/files/{file_id}`).

full_width.description:
Absent: unchanged. The editor column uses the whole pane width. Allowed on locked pages;
not an edit (`updated_by` / `updated_at` stay).

PageUser.description: A user named on a page (last editor, locker).

PageVersion.description: A stored version with its content.

content.description: BlockNote blocks as they were; opaque to the server.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) versions; `null` on the last page.

PageVersionSummary.description: A stored version without its content.

created_at.description: When the version was stored; the page looked like this at that moment.

oneOf.description: Who last edited this state (the importer for `import`); `null` when the user is gone.

can_delete.description: Whether the caller may delete this comment.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this comment.

can_change_role.description: Whether the caller may change this member's role.

can_remove.description: Whether the caller may remove this member (for the caller's own row: leave).

can_transfer_ownership.description: Whether the caller may hand the workspace over to this member.

suspended_at.description: Set while the user's account is suspended (they cannot sign in or be notified).

chat_conversation_id.description: Conversation and message of a `chat_mentioned` notification.

comment_id.description: The task comment of a `comment_mentioned` notification.

kind.description:
`task_assigned`, `comment_mentioned` (task comment), `page_comment_mentioned`,
`page_mentioned` (an @mention in a page body) or `chat_mentioned` (a chat message).

page_block_id.description: The block with the mention of a `page_mentioned` notification (a deep link anchor).

page_id.description:
Page, thread and comment of a `page_comment_mentioned` notification; the page of a
`page_mentioned` one.

auto_close_parent.description: Close a task automatically when all its sub-issues are done (rule A).

auto_close_sub_issues.description: Close open sub-issues when their parent closes (rule B).

blocked.description: True while at least one live task that is not completed, cancelled or a duplicate blocks it.

oneOf.description: The task this one duplicates; null when it is not a duplicate or its target is in the trash.
The parent while it is visible (live, in a live project); null otherwise.

parent_task_id.description: The direct parent; null for top-level tasks.

sub_issue_closed_count.description: Direct live children in a completed, cancelled or duplicate status.

trashed_descendant_count.description: Task trash only: descendants trashed together with this task (restored with it).

Permission.description:
A workspace capability that depends on the member's role. Actions open to
every member (tasks, projects, attachments, docs) are not listed here.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 response body with Orbit's stable machine-readable extensions.

auto_close_parent.description: Close a task automatically when all its sub-issues are done (rule A).

auto_close_sub_issues.description: Close open sub-issues when their parent closes (rule B).

ReadSnapshot.description: The states that "mark all as read" changed, as they were before, so the caller can undo it.

RecentPage.description: A page the caller opened recently.

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space.

teamspace_id.description: `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

visited_at.description: When the caller last opened the page.

RecentPageList.description: The caller's recently opened pages in this workspace, most recent first.

RelatedTask.description: The other task of a relation, as seen from the task being viewed.

ReplyPreviewRecord.description: The newest reply of a thread, shown under its root.

can_change_visibility.description: Whether the caller may change who sees this view.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may PATCH/DELETE this view.

favorite_position.description: The caller's sidebar position for this view; null when not a favorite.

icon.description: Icon name from the web app's icon set.

is_favorite.description: Whether the caller has favorited this view.

oneOf.description: Null when the stored state no longer parses; `state_error` then says why.

ranges.description: `[start, end)` offsets in `message.body` to highlight, in UTF-16 code units.

cursor.description: Null when there is nothing older.

ShortcutsBody.description:
Keyboard shortcut overrides: command id -> keys, or null for "no shortcut".
The web app owns the command ids and the key notation; the server only bounds the size.

ShowCompleted.description: Which tasks in a done category (completed, cancelled, duplicate) stay visible.

SubIssuesDisplay.description:
How a view shows sub-issues. `nested` and `flat` only change the client; `hidden` lists
top-level tasks only (`POST /tasks/query` `sub_issues`).

TaskBulkResponse.description: `POST /tasks/bulk`: the updated tasks (no further pages) plus the automation's changes.

path.description:
JSON path of the first invalid filter node, e.g. `filter.children[2].value`. Only set
for `invalid_filter`.

filter.description: The complete filter tree, including any preset and project scope.

parent_task_id.description: Only direct children of this task.

sub_issues.description: The view's sub-issue display; `hidden` returns top-level tasks only (default `nested`).

blocked.description: True while at least one live task that is not completed, cancelled or a duplicate blocks it.

oneOf.description: The task this one duplicates; null when it is not a duplicate or its target is in the trash.
The parent while it is visible (live, in a live project); null otherwise.

parent_task_id.description: The direct parent; null for top-level tasks.

sub_issue_closed_count.description: Direct live children in a completed, cancelled or duplicate status.

trashed_descendant_count.description: Task trash only: descendants trashed together with this task (restored with it).

TaskRef.description: A task reference small enough to embed; clients build the display identifier themselves.

project_key.description: The key of the task's (live) project, e.g. `ORB`.

direction.description: Outgoing when the viewed task is the relation's source (the blocker or the duplicate).

duplicate_of_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: mark this task as a duplicate of it. `null`: unmark.

parent_task_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: make this task its sub-issue. `null`: detach.

TaskUpdateResponse.description:
`POST /tasks` and `PATCH /tasks/{id}`: the task plus the tasks the sub-issue automation
changed.

is_default.description: True for the workspace's first teamspace by position; new root pages go there by default.

TextRange.description:
A span of a string in UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string indices): `start` inclusive, `end`
exclusive.

oneOf.description: Null until the caller follows the thread or has read it.

ThreadStateRecord.description: The caller's state in one thread.

TrashedPage.description: A page trashed directly; its descendants trashed with it are restored together.

can_purge.description: Whether the caller may delete this page forever.

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space.

teamspace_id.description: `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

icon.description: Icon name: ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`, up to 64 bytes.

view_ids.description: Every view the caller has favorited in this workspace, in the new order.

oneOf.description: Null when the stored state no longer parses; `state_error` then says why.

ViewState.description: Filter and display options shared by saved views and per-page preferences.

oneOf.description: Only the view's owner may change this.

permissions.description: What the caller's role may do in this workspace.
